name: Meal Planner
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y postgresql && sudo sed -i -E 's/(local +all +(postgres|all) +)peer/\1trust/; s/scram-sha-256/trust/g' /etc/postgresql/*/main/pg_hba.conf && sudo service postgresql restart && until pg_isready -h localhost -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done && (psql -h localhost -U postgres -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'meal_planner'" | grep -q 1 || psql -h localhost -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE meal_planner;') && pip install -r requirements.txt
